selection_credit: The twenty inherited contracts are selected for literal preservation and earn zero Vesper novelty or automatic completion credit.

selected_inherited.description: Preserve exact Neris corrected final 81a09dc4d26c86f2f6cd2bebd66598013400f425 and its fresh-live equality.
Preserve the retained non-terminal initial final and additive correction without rewriting either.
Preserve both Neris security findings, their corrections, and the bounded zero-reportable-finding final review.
Preserve one-successful-canonical-pass and no-post-success-replay discipline.
Preserve 23084 inherited effective negatives at zero Vesper credit.
Preserve 7678 inherited Method Flow methods and all failed and passing witnesses.
Preserve 152 open gaps and 150 exact gates without silent closure.
Preserve strict x1-before-x2 lifecycle separation.
Preserve only completed, represented, open_gap, and exact_gate as core outcomes.
Preserve owner-self-scoped exact-delta validation and exclude unchanged-history and sibling-lane scans.
Preserve sparse-before-materialization and the hard 2000-file rotation ceiling.
Preserve same-owner validation as non-independent evidence under shared infrastructure.
Preserve exact manifests, JSON parsing, privacy classes, staged review, ancestry, clean state, and fresh-live equality.
Preserve sibling and shared lanes as read-only and non-enumerated.
Preserve Tavian Sol as ON_STANDBY collaboration-subagent evidence and never a main-task substitute.
Preserve the active route Vesper Arlen to Lyren Moss to Ilyra Fen without precontact or substitution.
Preserve GMUT as a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research-model family without empirical confirmation.
Preserve THOS as bounded software or synthetic proxy evidence without production or operational proof.
Preserve Freed ID and CBR legal, privacy, remedy, affected-party, cultural, and Maori-authority gates.
Preserve NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20 and all identity, AGI or ASI, consciousness, personhood, Theory-of-Everything, and authority boundaries.

new_proposals.title: Owner-neutral route expectations
new_proposals.hypothesis: Parameterizing expected current owner and successor removes the inherited Neris-to-Vesper hardcode while preserving fail-closed route validation.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A mismatched current or next owner passes, a missing parameter broadens scope, or an inherited default silently authorizes a route.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Exact expected-current and expected-next values pass; omission or mismatch fails with no send authority.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed test, restore the previous bounded command behavior additively, and stop route preparation.

new_proposals.title: Duplicate-key JSON tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: Rejecting duplicate object keys prevents exact-delta receipts from hiding conflicting values under last-key-wins parsing.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A duplicate key parses as valid or ordinary unique-key JSON is rejected.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All unique-key delta JSON passes and every duplicate-key fixture is rejected with its path retained.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep ordinary parsing available only for diagnosis, retain the failing fixture, and do not issue JSON validation credit.

new_proposals.title: Unicode path collision tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: NFC and case-fold collision checks can identify ambiguous owner-delta paths before manifest or baton publication.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Two colliding paths receive independent credit or a noncolliding pair is falsely merged.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: NFC or case-fold collisions fail closed while distinct normalized paths remain distinct.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the ambiguous delta, retain the failed witness, and require an additive rename before validation.

new_proposals.title: Bidi and control-character filename refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded scanner can refuse bidi overrides and disallowed control characters in exact-delta path names.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A crafted control character reaches the manifest as ordinary text or safe Unicode names are rejected indiscriminately.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All preregistered controls are rejected and safe fixtures pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the candidate and stop publication until the path is additively corrected.

new_proposals.title: Git entry-kind and submodule refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: Recording old and new Git modes can fail closed on unexpected symlink, submodule, or type transitions in an owner delta.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Mode 120000 or 160000 is silently treated as a regular file, or a regular-file change is misclassified.
primary_source_needs: official Git diff and tree format documentation
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Regular files pass; symlink, gitlink, and unsupported type transitions are explicitly refused.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the affected path, retain the mode transition, and issue zero canonical credit.

new_proposals.title: Merkle-bound delta manifest
new_proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic binary Merkle root over sorted exact blob records gives a compact tamper-evident owner-delta commitment.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Reordering changes the root, a changed blob leaves the root unchanged, or platform newlines affect Git-blob commitments.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Identical sorted blob records reproduce one root and any leaf mutation changes it.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep the exact per-file hashes authoritative, retain the failed vector, and omit Merkle credit.

new_proposals.title: Canonical receipt digest
new_proposals.hypothesis: Sorting keys and using a fixed compact encoding can give receipts a deterministic content digest independent of pretty-print layout.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Equivalent payloads yield different digests or semantically different payloads yield the same tested digest.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Equivalent mappings share a digest and any value mutation changes it in all fixtures.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain ordinary SHA-256 file hashes and record canonicalization as failed without promotion.

new_proposals.title: File-backed baton integrity gate
new_proposals.hypothesis: A command bound to a repository-relative path, Git blob, SHA-256 digest, and 10000-to-100000 word range can prevent a stale or undersized baton from being routed.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A wrong digest, uncommitted path, path escape, or out-of-range baton passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only the exact committed relative path with matching digest and word range passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain PREPARED_NOT_SENT, fix the file additively, and never send from a failed integrity state.

new_proposals.title: Sparse-pattern and materialization receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: Recording literal sparse patterns before checkout and counting materialized plus owner-in-scope files can enforce the hard 2000-file ceiling.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An undeclared path materializes, a count reaches 2000 without stopping additions, or the receipt inventories sibling lanes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Declared patterns and bounded counts match the owned lane and remain below 2000.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop additions, retain the overage, close the current head if safe, and prepare a fresh sparse rotation.

new_proposals.title: Explicit changed-test dependency closure
new_proposals.hypothesis: A literal dependency allowlist can let modified tests import unchanged helpers without authorizing repository-wide discovery.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Tests import undeclared helpers, the validator scans all modules, or an unused declared dependency is silently accepted.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only declared exact paths are importable and every used helper is accounted for.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain discovery failure, add the minimum literal dependency only after review, and rerun the isolated component.

new_proposals.title: Deterministic test-output digest
new_proposals.hypothesis: Capturing exact module allowlist, command, exit status, counts, and normalized output digest can make the one canonical test witness attributable.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A different module set or failure produces the same receipt identity, or timestamps destabilize the digest.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Repeated synthetic normalization is stable while command or result mutations change the digest.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain raw bounded output externally, remove unstable fields from the digest contract, and rerun only the isolated preflight before terminal success.

new_proposals.title: Markdown target-boundary audit
new_proposals.hypothesis: A structural audit of exact-delta Markdown links can reject private absolute paths, unsafe schemes, and missing local targets without claiming accessibility completeness.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A private or unsafe target passes, or ordinary relative and HTTPS links are rejected.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Unsafe schemes and absolute private paths fail; bounded safe targets pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the broken target, correct the document additively, and issue zero Markdown credit until isolated validation passes.

new_proposals.title: Current auth and roster transition receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: Advancing current state from Neris-active to Vesper-active through validated schemas can remove stale routing while preserving prior delivery truth.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: The active owner or next edge is wrong, historical delivery is overwritten, Tavian becomes a main-task fallback, or schema validation fails.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Vesper v662-v4 is active, Lyren v662-v5 is next, prior facts remain visible, and both validators pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the exact prior files from retained backups only if validation fails, retain the attempted state as a failed witness, and stop routing.

new_proposals.title: Owner-neutral canonical aggregate
new_proposals.hypothesis: An owner-parameterized canonical command can bind Vesper, exact source, exact final, branch, delta, modules, manifests, privacy, security, and equality without inheriting Neris labels.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: The receipt reports Neris, validates a broader scope, accepts the wrong source/final, or replays after success.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: One exact-final invocation succeeds once for Vesper with literal allowlists and no replay.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: If it fails, retain zero aggregate credit, recover only the blocked component, and rerun the aggregate only before any success and only if the changed dependency requires it.

new_proposals.title: GMUT provenance functional
new_proposals.hypothesis: A typed provenance functional can represent how source, units, domain, calibration, and falsifier metadata accompany a GMUT model term.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: The formalism is dimensionally incoherent or is presented as a force, prediction, likelihood, constraint, or empirical confirmation.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The board remains internally typed and explicitly refuses empirical promotion.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reclassify as represented, retain the mismatch, and remove any unsupported physical claim.

new_proposals.title: THOS digital-preservation handover proxy
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic fixity, custody, exception, readback, escalation, workload, and shift-handover traces can test protocol state transitions.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An invalid transition passes or the synthetic protocol is described as real archival effectiveness or professional competence.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Synthetic valid transitions pass, invalid transitions fail, and all real-world claims remain absent.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain failed fixtures and reclassify the protocol as represented only.

new_proposals.title: Freed ID content-integrity profile
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic profile combining content digest, issuer intent, holder disclosure, status, recovery, and context binding can expose structural verification order.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Verification order ambiguity passes or synthetic vectors are promoted to real interoperability, privacy, security, or trust-governance evidence.
primary_source_needs: current W3C Verifiable Credentials and IETF selective-disclosure standards
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All declared synthetic order and binding checks pass while production remains false.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain failing vectors, refuse issuance or verification claims, and leave the item represented.

new_proposals.title: Structurally accessible evidence report
new_proposals.hypothesis: Semantic headings, tables, link labels, focus-independent reading order, and print fallback can improve structural accessibility of the static report.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Required structure is absent or automated structure is promoted to manual, assistive-technology, Maori-language, cognitive, or affected-user completion.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Declared structural checks pass and every manual or affected-user evaluation stays reserved.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Correct structural defects additively and retain all manual-evaluation gaps.

new_proposals.title: Independent digital-preservation corpus and audit
new_proposals.hypothesis: A separately governed real corpus and independent team could test external reproducibility and archival relevance.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: No authorized real rows, external team, preregistration, or independent audit is available.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain open_gap unless authorized real material and an independent team exist; this phase must ingest zero real rows.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before data access and retain the absence without substituting synthetic evidence.

new_proposals.title: CBR public-records remedy and Maori-authority matrix
new_proposals.hypothesis: A reservation matrix can make privacy, access, retention, remedy, legal, cultural, affected-party, tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori-authority dependencies explicit.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Repository software makes a real access, retention, remedy, legal, cultural, governance, or Maori-authority decision.
primary_source_needs: tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori authority
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain exact_gate with zero real decisions and all competent authorities named as external requirements.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the decision, retain the attempted boundary crossing, and seek exact competent authority outside this phase.

boundary: This immutable x1 freeze is planning evidence only. It does not implement x2, close any gate, validate a final commit, deliver a baton, or authorize Stage 20.
